title: Link the Value Worksheet from every pattern's value line?
summary: Open from Nov 19 chat. Proposal: at the end of each pattern page's "Value realized from pattern usage" line, add: "Count yours with the free Value Worksheet." linking to aisuccesspatterns.com/value/?p=<pattern name>, so the worksheet opens with that pattern picked. Nothing built yet. If Yes, I build it on a branch and you get a Publish / Hold item. (Check first that the worksheet reads ?p= - if it doesn't, I add that too, on the same branch.)
